questions.question: Name and explain the four management tasks, and explain why they form a cycle. How does the balance between them differ between top and lower management?
questions.expected_answer: Planning: setting goals and deciding how to reach them. Organising: dividing work, assigning people, allocating resources, setting authority lines. Leading/directing: instructing, communicating, motivating, resolving conflict. Control: setting standards, measuring, comparing, correcting. Cycle: control results feed the next round of planning. Top management spends most time on (strategic) planning; lower management spends most time leading and controlling daily work, with short-term operational planning.

questions.question: Write the supermarket's delivery goal as a SMART goal and explain delegation, including authority, responsibility and accountability.
questions.expected_answer: E.g. start a home delivery service in town within six months, reaching 400 deliveries a month by the third month (specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, time-bound). Delegation: giving a subordinate authority to do a task. Authority: right to make decisions/give instructions; responsibility: duty to do the task properly; accountability: answering for the result. Manager delegates authority and responsibility but remains accountable.

questions.question: Apply the four steps of control to the first month: standard 400 deliveries, actual 320, fee R35, running costs R12 600. Calculate the percentage achieved and the shortfall in fees against costs, and suggest corrective action.
questions.expected_answer: Standard: 400. Measure: 320. Compare: 320 ÷ 400 = 80%, short by 80 deliveries. Fees 320 × 35 = R11 200; costs R12 600; shortfall R1 400 (break-even 12 600 ÷ 35 = 360 deliveries). Correct: find causes (customers unaware, unanswered phone); advertise on till slips and social media, staff the order phone at peak times. Month 3: 450 × 35 = R15 750, R3 150 above costs.
